svg.aria-label: Technical skills. Hydrological modeling: SWAT and SWAT+, multi-objective calibration and validation (NSE, KGE), streamflow simulation, parameter regionalization for ungauged basins. Climate data: CMIP6, bias correction and downscaling, solar geoengineering scenarios (SAI, G6sulfur), hydrometeorological indices, drought propagation. Machine learning: scikit-learn, XGBoost, Random Forest, residual error learning for hybrid physics and ML models. Scientific computing: Python (NumPy, pandas, xarray), R, Streamlit, Rust. Geospatial: QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, Rasterio, GeoPandas. Software: Git, GitHub Actions, Python packaging and CLIs, config-driven pipelines (pydantic, YAML).
